shield_and_bonding: Each coax shield bonded to GND at the U.FL jack and at the carrier; the two shields are separate conductors. Shield cans are on board ground through their clips.
length_status: estimated from layout, confirm on first build
protection_upstream: Bias current limit 2.0 mA at the source (head circuit_description.md section 3); no fuse
strain_relief: Adhesive tack at both ends; lay in the chimney channel; locking MHF-LK plugs fit the same U.FL receptacle
note: bias coax shield = bias return

cable_title: LAB ONLY: J1X extension, 2 m, M16 plug (robot end) to M16 socket (head end), straight through + 1.50 kohm LAB resistor
conductor_insulation: silicone-rubber insulated, tinned fine-strand copper (class value -60 C; supplier part TBD - not in sources; UNVERIFIED). PVC excluded (not rated -40 C)
shield_and_bonding: Continuous braid end to end.
length_status: estimated from layout, confirm on first build
protection_upstream: Same upstream protection as W-008/W-101 (eFuses 1.51 A and 4.05 A); LAB mode adds no fuse
strain_relief: Strain-relief clamps in both backshells; support the head and cable independently of the entrance window (head_icd.md section 7)
note: AWG 18 recommended: meets 0.125 ohm
